Aisha: Quick update 7: we're moving tonight's all-hands start by +6 minutes to finish an AV patch. New start 16:06 PT. Sorry for the ping.
Diego: Fine by me. Is this the slide-swap issue again?
Aisha: Yes, slides+live edge were stepping on each other causing dropped segments. Ops applied a write-lock on slide-change events.
Sam: Suggestion: add a 10s buffer in the agenda between roadmap and demos so any recorder hitches won't clip demos.
Aisha: Good idea. Adding a 2-min buffer after roadmap and pausing live captions for demos that play local audio.
OpsBot: rolling update: slide-change-debounce=200ms deployed to all-hands cluster. result=ok (4.8s)
VidBot: recorder: enabling "dual_persist" (local+S3) for session 1765704321. OK
Renee: Presenters: please join the prep room 12m before so ops can map USB devices. If you use system audio, notify me here.
Kai: For Q&A planning: can we reserve 10 minutes after leadership for live questions, then collect follow-ups here?
Aisha: Yes  we'll reserve 10 min. If we run over we'll capture remaining Qs and answer asynchronously. Leadership, if you want pre-read Qs drop them now.
Diego: Leadership Q: what's the plan for expanding dedicated capacity in EU next quarter? Can we get a short bullet to cover?
Aisha: Noted. I'll ask Product to prepare a 2-slide summary for the leadership segment.
Sam: Ops note: avoid using "share computer sound" in slides. It creates a second audio track the recorder can't stitch. Use our DeckAudio channel.
OpsBot: preflight: recorder-0 cpu=16% mem=48% disk=60% jitter=3ms segments_ok
Renee: Mic-checks at prep room in 10. I'll test USB mics and screen-share audio.
Kai: If the stream buffers, restart recorder gracefully: `ssh ops@recorder-01 sudo systemctl restart recorder` then ping #eng-sre.
Aisha: Thanks. Drop any urgent Qs for leadership here and I'll prioritize them for the live Q&A. See you soon :wave:
